one_liner: Even across the 3-season sample, LeBron James shot 52.3 percent from the field while averaging 24.8 points and 8.3 assists per 36 minutes.
three_things: A 52.3 percent field-goal mark is rich for a perimeter creator, and it sits alongside an 8.3 assists-per-36 playmaking load.
The scoring rate is 24.8 points per 36 minutes across 201 games in the window.
Free throws are the soft spot: 75.6 percent, the weakest number in an otherwise efficient line.
context_note: Numbers are per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not a full career; the manifest is descriptive_only, with no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor. A rate says nothing about how those minutes were used or against whom.
